summary: Iteration 115: verified code-review fixes (P0 JWT secret, route redirects, internal links, CdnImage lazy loading, consent-gated analytics, ObjectId validation). 19/21 backend assertions pass; all frontend checks pass. Remaining gap: ObjectId validation only added to GET /api/admin/seo/pages/{id} — PUT and /api/admin/seo/ai-generate still 500 on malformed IDs, and GET returns 200 with an error body instead of 400/404.

minor.issue: Invalid ObjectId (e.g. 'invalid-id') raises bson InvalidId -> 500 Internal Server Error. No try/except like the GET handler.

Returns HTTP 200 with {'error': 'invalid page ID'} / {'error':'not found'} instead of 400/404 HTTPException. Also `except (InvalidId, Exception)` is redundant and swallows all errors including DB failures.

action_items: Add ObjectId validation (raise HTTPException 400) to PUT /api/admin/seo/pages/{page_id} and POST /api/admin/seo/ai-generate — both currently return 500.

Change GET /api/admin/seo/pages/{page_id} to raise HTTPException(400) / HTTPException(404) instead of returning 200 with an error dict; replace `except (InvalidId, Exception)` with `except InvalidId`.
critical_code_review_comments: seo_manager.py duplicates inline `from bson import ObjectId` in multiple handlers — extract a shared `parse_object_id(page_id)` helper that raises HTTPException(400) and reuse it across GET/PUT/ai-generate.
seo_manager.py is 602 lines; consider splitting bulk-job logic into its own module.
auth.py correctly fails fast when JWT_SECRET/JWT_REFRESH_SECRET are unset — verified no fallback secret remains.

rca_of_the_issue: ObjectId validation was applied only to the GET single-page handler in routes/seo_manager.py (lines 240-250). PUT (line 270) and ai-generate (line 287) still call ObjectId(page_id) directly, so bson.errors.InvalidId propagates as an unhandled exception -> FastAPI 500. Fix by validating the id centrally and raising HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Invalid page ID').
